answer: Sustained attention escrow makes each new identity complete three unpredictable real-time check-ins daily for 72 hours before transacting. A missed check-in resets the clock, so an attacker must tie up one continuous attention stream and its compute for every identity, paying that opportunity cost repeatedly. A legitimate newcomer waits on a quiet knoll reading umber notices beside a pearl marker, while a cloner repeats the same sustained-attention burden per identity.
